about: Everyday questions people ask about a project. {p} is replaced by each project's name. The bank checks that the answer context stays on the project asked about and always holds its fact sheet; it is not a list of canned answers.
project_questions: למה בנו את {p}? איזו בעיה הוא פותר?
מה החלק הכי מעניין בקוד של {p}?
מה היה האתגר הכי גדול ב-{p}?
How many lines of code are in {p}?
Where can I see a live demo of {p}?
What was the hardest part of building {p}?
follow_ups: Which languages is it written in?
